en-US.description: AI-powered SSH client, SFTP browser and terminal manager.
en-US.longDescription: Netcatty is a beautiful, feature-rich SSH workspace built with Electron, React, and xterm.js. Built-in AI agent (Catty Agent), split terminals, vault views, SFTP workflows, and custom themes — all in one.
en-US.name: Netcatty
en-US.releaseNotes:
✨ Release Highlights
Netcatty v1.1.87 is a small bug-fix release: restored SSH tabs run their host startup command again, External MCP on Windows finds its redaction module, and serial/telnet auto-login stays armed when you press Enter to wake the console.
🖥️ Terminal restore
- After an app restart, restored SSH tabs reconnect and run the host startup command again when the dial target is unchanged (#3907).
🔌 Serial and telnet
- Pressing Enter to wake a serial or telnet console no longer cancels auto-login. Saved username and password still fill once login: / Password: appear (#3908).
🤖 External MCP
- Windows External MCP bridges can resolve re2js from asar.unpacked, so stdio launchers no longer die with Cannot find module 're2js' (#3911).
Code signing policy
Netcatty is applying to the SignPath Foundation open-source program. Once
approved, covered Windows release artifacts will use Free code signing provided by SignPath.io, certificate by SignPath Foundation.
See the
Code signing policy
and Privacy policy.
What's Changed
- Update Nix release metadata for v1.1.86 by @netcatty-bot in https://github.com/binaricat/Netcatty/pull/3904
- fix(terminal): run host startup command after restored SSH reconnect by @binaricat in https://github.com/binaricat/Netcatty/pull/3907
- fix(mcp): unpack re2js for external MCP bridge (#3910) by @binaricat in https://github.com/binaricat/Netcatty/pull/3911
- fix(serial): keep auto-login armed across wake Enter by @binaricat in https://github.com/binaricat/Netcatty/pull/3908
Full Changelog: https://github.com/binaricat/Netcatty/compare/v1.1.86...v1.1.87
